Container.Name: runelite-web
Container.Overview:
Play Old School RuneScape with RuneLite from any web browser. The game runs on your server and is streamed to your browser, with nothing to install on the device you play from. Log in with your Jagex Account through the bundled open-source Bolt launcher.
Set a web password, and don't expose the port to the internet without a VPN or an authenticating proxy: whoever opens the page controls your account.
Container.Requires: Bolt's embedded browser needs the seccomp=unconfined and shm-size settings in Extra Parameters (already filled in). x86-64 CPUs only.

Config.Name: WebUI (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Port you open in your browser (self-signed HTTPS). Change it if 38443 is taken.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Bolt login, RuneLite settings and plugins, and logs

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Password for the web page. Required: without it, anyone who can reach the page can play your account.

Config.Name: Launch mode
Config.Description: bolt = Jagex Account login via Bolt. runelite = start RuneLite directly (legacy accounts or credentials.properties).

Config.Name: Stream frame rate
Config.Description: Initial fps, then the allowed range. Lower = less CPU. Use 60,8-60 on fast CPUs.

Config.Name: WebUI (HTTP, reverse proxy only)
Config.Description: Optional plain-HTTP port for a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel that handles TLS. Leave empty if unused.

Config.Name: Use GPU for Bolt
Config.Description: Only set true if you pass a working GPU (/dev/dri) into the container.

Config.Name: RuneLite Java options
Config.Description: Extra JVM flags for direct RuneLite launches
